facts.text: I have been trying to get back into a consistent exercise routine.
I realized I need to work on stretching and flexibility.
I am going to make stretching and flexibility a priority for the next few weeks.
I want yoga or Pilates routines for beginners that I can do at home.
I have a busy schedule and I want tips to fit the routines into it.
I want yoga or Pilates videos that focus on increasing flexibility and range of motion.
I want the videos to focus especially on my hips and hamstrings.
I want to incorporate these videos into my routine.
I am not sure how to fit the videos in.
I have spin classes as part of my routine.
I have bodyweight exercises as part of my routine.
I am concerned about fitting Pilates and yoga videos on Tuesdays and Fridays because I usually have a lot of work to do on those days.
I want to do the Pilates and yoga videos on Wednesdays instead.
I want to take a rest day on Fridays.
I want to switch the focus of my bodyweight exercises on Sundays to focus on lower body instead of core.
I think the revised schedule is more manageable for me.
I will try to stick to the revised schedule as much as possible and adjust as needed.
